geographic_scope: Comuna 8 / Villa Hermosa, Medellín. Current proving ground remains Llanaditas / upper Comuna 8. Moravia is a learning case, not a target of this registry.
guardrail: This layer traces published local planning and research. It is documentary alignment, not community endorsement, not a numeric local calibration, and not a substitute for co-design.

entries.plan_action: Household and neighborhood rainwater capture as a water-management / hillside-load reduction measure already present in Comuna 8 adaptation practice.
entries.source_title: How one Medellín neighbourhood changed how a whole city plans for climate change
supports: Rainwater capture is a documented local adaptation practice in Comuna 8
does_not_establish: A calibrated slope-load reduction coefficient for Llanaditas
Community endorsement of a specific Ourea portfolio
prerequisites: Roof access and storage specification agreed with residents
Maintenance and training arrangements before treating capture as durable
entries.evidence_gap: No transferable Comuna 8 unit cost or locally calibrated slope-benefit coefficient is encoded in the optimizer.

entries.plan_action: Surface-water management and drainage works as part of neighborhood climate-risk reduction, not as a standalone early-warning product.
entries.source_title: La comuna Villa Hermosa es ejemplo en Medellín en gestión frente al cambio climático
supports: Drainage and surface-water management appear in published Comuna 8 climate-risk practice
does_not_establish: Hydraulic capacity of mapped drainage corridors
prerequisites: Corridor and outlet conditions confirmed in the field
Everyday access and care routes reviewed before construction
entries.evidence_gap: Mapped drainage-corridor proxy is not drainage capacity. Hydraulic design remains an engineering follow-up.

entries.plan_action: Nature-based / bioengineering slope work aligned with published informal-area climate-resilience guidance.
entries.source_title: Strategy paper on nature-based solutions to build climate resilience in informal areas
entries.geographic_scope: Informal and marginalized hillside settlements, applied here only as documentary typology alignment
supports: Nature-based slope work is a recognized intervention family for informal hillside settlements
does_not_establish: A locally calibrated restoration effect range
Community agreement on tenure or maintenance
prerequisites: Species, tenure and maintenance capacity agreed locally
Maturity delay acknowledged; year-1 effect is not full prior effect
entries.evidence_gap: UN-Habitat guidance is not a Medellín species list or a calibrated restoration effect range.

entries.plan_action: Community organization in Comuna 8 has a documented path from protest to proposal; Ourea treats that as a participation-design lesson, not as a completed consultation record.
entries.source_title: From protesting to proposing: the evolution of community organization in Comuna 8, Medellín
supports: Comuna 8 has a documented history of organized proposal-making
does_not_establish: That any named organization is an Ourea partner
Community review of a generated portfolio
Consent for a specific cell-level intervention
prerequisites: Legitimate representatives identified in the pilot
Veto criteria recorded without converting them into hidden optimizer weights
entries.evidence_gap: No organization is named as a confirmed Ourea partner. The shipped community_evidence.json has no records, so every project is not assessed.

entries.plan_action: Metropolitan evidence that socio-natural hazard exposure is concentrated among urban poor, without being exclusive to them.
entries.source_title: Urban poor are the most endangered by socio-natural hazards, but not exclusively: the 2025 Granizal Landslide case
entries.geographic_scope: Granizal, Medellín metropolitan area — mechanism evidence, not Llanaditas calibration
supports: Unequal exposure to socio-natural hazards in the Medellín metropolitan area
Why equity weighting belongs in portfolio comparison
does_not_establish: Community endorsement of an Ourea portfolio
A transferable runout or triggering threshold for Comuna 8
prerequisites: Keep Granizal as metropolitan mechanism evidence, not as a substitute proving ground
entries.evidence_gap: The paper does not calibrate Ourea's planning-credit model or community-safeguard records.
